---
title: "Join two tables"
---

Add the airport name and altitude to the weather readings at the three New
York City airports at 9 a.m. on January 1, 2013.
[`weather`](https://github.com/phpstats/datasets#weather) has hourly readings
from 2013, and [`airports`](https://github.com/phpstats/datasets#airports) has
the name and altitude, in feet, of 1,458 US airports, keyed by FAA code. Both
are from nycflights13.

{{< include pages/_join.md >}}

- `by: ['origin' => 'faa']` matches `origin` in `weather` with `faa` in
  `airports`, and the result keeps the name `origin`.
- `left_join()` keeps every row of `weather` in its original order. A reading
  with no matching airport would get NA in the new columns. Airports with no
  readings are left out.
- `relationship: 'many-to-one'` throws an exception if a code matches more
  than one airport.
- `hour` is local time, and `time_hour` prints the same instant in UTC.
- `inner_join()` drops the readings with no match. `full_join()` also keeps
  the airports with no readings and adds them after the matched rows.

Reference: [Joins, binding, and set operations](../reference/two-table.qmd#joins)
